faqs.question: When is Duha prayer prayed?
faqs.answer: Duha is prayed after the sun has risen and before Dhuhr. Many teachers advise waiting until the sun is clearly up and avoiding the time just before Dhuhr.

faqs.question: How many rak'ahs are in Duha prayer?
faqs.answer: Many Muslims pray Duha as two rak'ahs, while narrations and local teaching may include four, eight, or more. Follow your madhhab or local scholar.

faqs.question: Is Duha the same as Ishraq?
faqs.answer: Some communities use Ishraq for Duha prayed near the beginning of its time, while others treat the names differently. Follow the terminology taught in your community.

faqs.question: How do you pray Duha prayer?
faqs.answer: Duha is commonly prayed in sets of two rak'ahs using the familiar salah sequence. Two rak'ahs are a simple place to begin; follow your madhhab or teacher for additional details.

hero.introductionHtml: Duha is a voluntary prayer offered after sunrise and before Dhuhr, turning the quiet part of the morning into worship and gratitude.
hero.summaryHtml:
• When: after sunrise and before Dhuhr.
  • Category: voluntary or Nafl prayer.
  • Common form: often prayed as two rak'ahs, with other counts taught too.
  • Note: exact start/end details differ by local teaching.
